content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo indkhan/Moneo. GitHub issue #268, part 3 only (read `gh issue view 268 --comments`, and AGENTS.md): `lib/ai/use-voice-call.ts` silently drops the voice call record (transcript/summary) when it can't be saved because the device is offline; today it's routed to a handler named `callRecordIsNotSavedWhenOffline`. Another PR is doing parts 1 and 2 of #268 in other files; don't touch those.

Owner's decision: queue and retry. When saving the call record fails because of the network, keep the record in the browser (IndexedDB) and save it automatically when the connection returns (`online` event) or the next time Moneo is opened; show a small, unobtrusive "saved when you're back online" note on the call screen/end-of-call state. Requirements:
- Saving must be idempotent so a retry after a lost response never creates a duplicate record (reuse a client-generated id or the existing request id the save route already accepts; if the route has no idempotency key, add one server side, checked against the owner's workspace).
- Only network failures are queued; a 4xx (e.g. validation or auth) is surfaced as now, not retried forever. Bound retries and drop nothing silently: if a queued record can't be saved for a non-network reason, tell the owner.
- IndexedDB access can throw (private window, blocked storage): fall back to surfacing the failure, as today.
- Queued records belong to this owner's workspace; never send one to a different workspace.
- Use the shared timer hooks from `lib/use-polling.ts` / `lib/use-timeout.ts` (raw timers are banned in client code by lint) where you need timing.
- Works on desktop (window loads `http://localhost:47300`) and source install; phone via Tailscale too.
Tests: the queue/retry/idempotency logic as a plain `lib/` module with fake timers and a fake IndexedDB/storage seam (at most ~3 mocks); one test that a duplicate retry doesn't create a second record (server side if you add the key). Screenshots of the note via the verify-ui skill if feasible, else say so.

Create branch `t3/issue-268-voice-record-offline` from origin/main. Commit in steps with plain messages ending with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". If you need a migration, use a prefix later than the newest on main and run `npm run db:types`; if you apply it to moneo-qa, revert it afterwards without CASCADE. Real AI calls cost money: mock them. Before opening the PR, merge origin/main again. Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` yourself and quote their last lines. Tests use only the moneo-qa test backend; never the owner's backend (.env, Docker project `moneo`, port 3000). Never run `qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`. Never kill a process you didn't start (verify by PID). Don't end your turn while a command is still running. No comments in code. Open the PR (body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)"), never merge it. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>.

gh pr create --base main --title "Queue the voice call record offline and save it when back online (#268)" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Part 3 of #268. The call record used to be silently dropped when saving it failed offline.

- **Queue and retry.** When saving fails on the network (fetch error, 502/503/504) the record is kept in IndexedDB and saved on the `online` event and on the next open, with retries every 30 s (at most 5) while the browser is online but the server is unreachable. A small note says it will be saved when back online, and another says when it was.
- **No silent drops.** A 4xx is shown as an error, not queued. A queued record the server rejects is reported each time and given up on (still reported) after 3 rejections. If IndexedDB is blocked the failure is shown. Entries for another workspace are never sent.
- **Idempotent.** The record already carries a client-generated id and the route treats a duplicate insert as done. Now it also checks that the existing row belongs to this workspace (409 otherwise), and the record carries `workspaceId` (returned by `/api/voice/call` at call start), which the route checks against the signed-in workspace.
- **Where it lives.** Logic is `lib/ai/voice-record-queue.ts`; `components/pending-call-records.tsx` (mounted in the layout) flushes and shows the notes, because the call screen is gone by the time the record is saved.

Checked in the QA app with real IndexedDB: a queued record stayed pending while `/api/voice/calls` was blocked, saved once when it came back (one row, none on a repeated flush), and an entry for another workspace was left alone. Screenshots (light, dark, mobile) are in `.qa/shots/offline-note/` locally (git-ignored).

No migration, no new dependency. The raw IndexedDB wrapper is exercised in the browser check, not unit tests.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)"

content.text:
Part 3 of #268 is done and the PR is open. When saving the call record fails because of the network, the record now stays in the browser and is saved automatically later.

- **When it retries:** on the `online` event and the next time Moneo opens. Retries stop after 5 attempts at 30-second intervals while the browser is online but the server is unreachable. A "saved when you're back online" note shows while a record is pending, and a "Your call was saved." note shows when it goes through.
- **Where the note shows:** the note is mounted in the layout (`components/pending-call-records.tsx`), not on the call screen. The call screen is already closed by the time the record is saved.
- **Idempotency:** the save route already treated a repeated id as done. It now also checks that the existing row belongs to the owner's workspace and returns 409 otherwise. The record also carries a `workspaceId`, which `/api/voice/call` returns at call start. The route returns 409 if it doesn't match the signed-in workspace, and the client never sends a queued record for another workspace.
- **Failures:** only fetch errors and 502/503/504 are queued. Any other error is shown to the owner instead of retried. A queued record the server keeps rejecting is reported each time and dropped after 3 rejections, with a final message. If IndexedDB is blocked, the failure is shown as before.
- **Tests:** `lib/ai/voice-record-queue.test.ts` covers queueing, retry, duplicate retry after a lost response, the rejection bound and other-workspace entries. The route tests cover the workspace check, including a reused id from another workspace. None of them use fake timers, because the queue module itself has no timers (the 30-second retry is in the component).

I also ran it in the QA app with real IndexedDB:
- With `/api/voice/calls` blocked, the record stayed pending and the note showed.
- Once unblocked, it saved as one row, and a repeat flush added none.
- An entry for another workspace was left untouched.

Screenshots in light, dark and mobile are in `.qa/shots/offline-note/` locally; that folder is git-ignored, so they aren't in the PR. The raw IndexedDB wrapper is only exercised by that browser run, not by unit tests.
